name: Xiaomi X20+ (EU)

radios.note: No Xiaomi page found that names the radio; control is through the Xiaomi Home app.

matter.note: No Matter claim on Xiaomi's pages and no CSA listing surfaced in search.

apple_home.note: No Xiaomi or Apple page found that lists Apple Home or Matter for this model.

google_home.note: Xiaomi's global and UK store pages list voice control with Google Assistant (e.g. "OK Google, start cleaning"), not available in every language and country. Spain-page wording not confirmed.

alexa.note: Xiaomi's global and UK store pages list voice control with Alexa (e.g. "Alexa, start cleaning") and say a compatible Alexa device is needed. Spain-page wording not confirmed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Xiaomi Miio integration covers Xiaomi robot vacuums in general, but no official page found names the X20+. Community HACS integrations are not counted.

hubRequired.note: Xiaomi's pages describe app control and do not mention a hub; not stated explicitly.

localControl.note: Xiaomi does not say whether any control works without its cloud.

cleaning.note: Spain spec page lists two mop-pad holders with two pads in the box.

navigation.note: Xiaomi's AU page lists LDS laser navigation and S-Cross structured-light obstacle avoidance.

suctionPa.note: Xiaomi states 6000 Pa on its Spain and AU pages.

selfEmptying.note: The Spain spec page lists the station's power draw while emptying dust and a disposable bag in the box; this is the X20+ bundle (the plain X20 has no such base).

summary: Xiaomi lists Alexa and Google Assistant voice control for the Robot Vacuum X20+, and control runs through the Xiaomi Home app. The EU model is a vacuum and mop with LDS laser navigation, 6000 Pa suction and a station that empties the bin. Matter, Apple Home and SmartThings aren't confirmed.
caveats: Xiaomi says voice control isn't available in every language and country, and the Spain page wording isn't confirmed.
The plain X20 has no self-emptying base; the station comes with the X20+ bundle.
Home Assistant's Xiaomi Miio integration covers Xiaomi vacuums in general, but no official page names the X20+.
